## Case studies

- [Electrum Dependency Analysis Framework](https://tristanvisser.co.za/work/electrum-dependency-engine/): Java and Spring Boot dependency graph engine for Maven breakage analysis and automated version-bump pull requests.
- [Hackathon Hosting Platform](https://tristanvisser.co.za/work/hackathon-hosting-platform/): Full-stack platform with teams, a collaborative editor, sandboxed Python judging and live leaderboards.
- [P2P File Sharing and RBUDP](https://tristanvisser.co.za/work/p2p-encrypted-file-sharing/): Encrypted peer-to-peer file sharing with a custom reliable UDP protocol benchmarked against TCP.
- [Parallel Othello MCTS](https://tristanvisser.co.za/work/parallel-othello-mcts/): Distributed Monte Carlo Tree Search player in C and MPI, reaching 1.3 million simulations per second at eight processes.
- [BPE DFA Tokenizer](https://tristanvisser.co.za/work/bpe-dfa-tokenizer/): BPE tokenization automata with differential tests, benchmarks and two theoretical extensions.
- [Smart Track Organizer Pro](https://tristanvisser.co.za/work/smart-track-organizer/): REAPER session organizer with a studio lexicon, live preview and folder automation.
- [WISTL Compiler](https://tristanvisser.co.za/work/wistl-compiler/): Compiler for a small LL(1) language, from scanner and parser to type checking and JVM class files.

## Notes

- The case studies describe work Tristan actually did, including the problem, decisions and trade-offs.
- Source code is available on request where no public repository is linked.
- The site does not publish invented metrics, testimonials or client claims.
